instructions.title: Technical Instructions
instructions.subtitle: Artwork and file delivery
instructions.boxOverprint: Leave the die-cut drawings set to overprint in their separate layers (do not merge them into the full colour artwork)
instructions.boxNoPms: Do not use PMS colours; set the artwork up in full colour
instructions.boxTrimbox: Leave the trimbox as it is; do not enlarge or move it
instructions.boxThreePdfs: Deliver as three separate PDFs (unless the printing for the small boxes is identical)
instructions.warnFrontSmallBoxes: The front of the small boxes is the side with the two notches.
instructions.warnSleeveOrientation: If text is placed on the side and spine of the outer box, please check that it is not upside down once folded.
instructions.endUserIntro: Would you like to supply instructions with the game? There are several options:
instructions.endUserOption1: Incorporate the written instructions directly into the box design, for example on the back or on the inside of the lid
instructions.endUserOption2: Place a QR code on the box linking to https://www.qrsong.io/en/how-to
instructions.endUserOption3: Create your own instructions page on your own website and place a QR code on the box linking to it
instructions.endUserOption4: Or sacrifice one card from the set and replace it with your own instruction card (this must meet the same guidelines as the other QR cards, see section 2)
instructions.cardSize: The cards have a format of {{size}} (final format after cutting)
instructions.cardBleed: The outer 3mm all round is treated as bleed and is cut off the card
instructions.cardShift: Please bear in mind that a shift of 1-2mm can still occur after cutting. Therefore keep important text, borders and elements at least 5mm (3mm bleed + 2mm tolerance) from the outer edge
instructions.cardQrCenter: QR codes will be placed in the centre of the card
instructions.cardImages: For the front and back, supply a square image of at least 1600x1600 pixels, delivered as PSD
instructions.cardContrast: The QR scanner works best with a darker QR code on a lighter background
instructions.cardPsd: Deliver the design as a PSD file, with the QR code in a separate layer so that it can be switched off
instructions.cardMetaLayer: Also place the artist, title and year on the back in a separate layer, so that these can be switched off if required
instructions.cardFont: If a different font is required, it must be chosen from Google Fonts
instructions.tipContent: Ensure sufficient contrast between the QR code and the background. A dark QR code (black, dark blue, dark green) on a light background (white, cream, light grey) gives the best results.
instructions.footerContact: Questions about these instructions? Please contact your account manager.

pricing.partnerTitle: Working with QRSong! as a reseller
pricing.partnerIntro: You sell the game to your clients; we make it. This is how we work with resellers.
pricing.partnerMarginCopy: You buy at the purchase price and set your own selling price. Our recommended price (RRP) is what end clients pay when they come to us directly, so we never undercut you.
pricing.partnerClientsCopy: We never approach or serve a client who comes to us through you, and we never show your editions to others without asking you first.
pricing.partnerForwardCopy: Ask us for the client edition of this brochure: the same information, without any prices and without our contact details.
pricing.partnerSamplesCopy: Free sample boxes of all three sizes in the standard QRSong! design, for you or sent straight to your client. A mockup with your client's logo shows the idea; it is not a design.
pricing.partnerNeutralCopy: Templates and technical instructions without our details, on request. Our name on the box is not required.
pricing.partnerDeliveryCopy: To your warehouse or straight to your client, with your order number on the packing slip.
pricing.partnerTextMeta: For your offers and your webshop
pricing.partnerText: The music game with your own cards. Every card plays one song in the free QRSong! app: guess the year, build your timeline and find out who knows their music best. The box and the cards are printed in your own design, with your own playlist. Available with 48, 96 or 192 cards, from 100 boxes.
pricing.howLeadStrong: A music game with your own cards.
pricing.howLeadBody: Every card holds one song: a QR code on one side, the artist, title and release year on the other. Players listen, guess the year and build a timeline. Who knows their music best?
pricing.howStep1Copy: Scan a card with the free QRSong! app. The song starts, the title stays hidden.
pricing.howStep2Copy: Released before or after the cards in your timeline? Put the card where you think it belongs.
pricing.howStep3Copy: Turn the card over. Right, and the card is yours. Wrong, and it goes under the pile.
pricing.howStep4Copy: The first player with ten cards in the right order wins. Name the artist or title for a bonus.
pricing.howAppCopy: Players use the free QRSong! app for iPhone and Android. No account with us and nothing for IT to install. The game rules are one scan away, in the language of the phone.
pricing.howMusicCopy: The song plays through the player's own streaming account, so no music licences are needed. Every card works with five services; if one service drops a song, the card still plays on the others.
pricing.svcYoutube: Opens the song in the YouTube Music app
pricing.svcNote: Without a subscription, some services play a shorter fragment.

pricing.faqSubQ: Do players need a streaming subscription?
pricing.faqSubA: The song plays through the player's own Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, Tidal or YouTube Music account. Most people already have one of these.
pricing.faqLicA: No. The song plays through the player's own streaming account, exactly as if they started it themselves. The app only presses play.
pricing.faqAppA: The free QRSong! app for iPhone and Android. The cards only play in this app.
pricing.faqGoneQ: What if a song disappears from a service?
pricing.faqGoneA: We keep the links up to date and can repair a link remotely. If one service removes a song, the card still plays on the other services.
pricing.faqDeleteQ: Can we delete the playlist afterwards?
pricing.faqDeleteA: Yes. Keep it public until the cards are made; after that the cards no longer need it, and they cannot be traced to your account.
pricing.faqAbroadQ: Does it work in other countries?
pricing.faqAbroadA: Yes. The streaming services work across borders, and the game rules open in the language of the phone, in twelve languages.
pricing.faqReorderA: Yes. Reorder the same box from 100 boxes, or make a new edition with new songs.
pricing.faqWrapA: No. They come loose in cartons, with the cards already in the box, ready to hand out.
pricing.faqMadeA: Printed and packed in the Netherlands.
pricing.faqSampleQ: Can we see a sample first?
pricing.faqSampleA: Yes. We send sample boxes of all three sizes in the standard QRSong! design, free of charge. Your own design follows in the digital proof.
pricing.faqSampleResellerA: Yes. Free sample boxes of all three sizes in the standard QRSong! design, for you or sent straight to your client.
pricing.faqSampleClientA: Yes. Ask your contact person for sample boxes of all three sizes, in the standard QRSong! design.
pricing.faqSmallA: Then a personal card set from our website fits better: your own playlist and card design, without the printed box.
pricing.faqSmallResellerA: We cannot print a custom box below 100. Ask us: for small numbers we look for a solution together.
pricing.faqMoreCopy: Mail us at {{email}}. We usually reply within one working day.
pricing.faqMoreClientCopy: Ask your contact person. You will have an answer quickly.
